reason: I already have Fold and INDmoney pulling my bank spends through AA for free, and I barely open those. Paying 99 a month for AI photos and a coach chat on top of a tracker I would also ignore makes no sense to me.
objection: It is basically another expense tracker, and I already have free ones that do the auto-fill part. Also a brand new app from one developer with no reviews asking to link my bank makes me nervous.
would_change_my_mind: If it actually cut my Swiggy and Zomato spending in a visible way within the free version first, like showing me I saved a couple of thousand in a month, I might try Pro.
